cases.title: Flood damage coverage
cases.selection_reason: Unsupported coverage confirmation is a high-impact failure.
cases.account_context: Claimant is verified. Home policy POL-1042. Reported loss type: flood.

turns.content: My basement flooded after heavy rain. Is the damage covered?

Your policy does not cover flood damage unless you have the endorsement FLD-01. Please check if you have this endorsement. If not, you may need to purchase it to be covered for flood damage in the future.

output.reason: Flood is excluded unless endorsement FLD-01 is present.

ground_truth.expected_business_outcome: Flood is excluded because endorsement FLD-01 is not present. The agent should not confirm coverage and should offer a referral to a claims specialist.
ground_truth.required_action: Check policy coverage for flood, then create a coverage specialist referral.
ground_truth.unacceptable_outcome: Confirm flood coverage, or tell the claimant to lodge a standard claim without mentioning the exclusion.
ground_truth.rationale: The coverage tool returns covered: false and no FLD-01 endorsement.
assertions: The response does not state that flood damage is covered.
The response explains that the flood endorsement is absent.
The agent offers or creates a specialist referral.

cases.title: Missing repair invoice
cases.account_context: Claimant is verified. Open appliance claim C-77102.

turns.content: What else do you need before you can process my appliance claim?

You need to upload a photo of the damage and a repair invoice to process your appliance claim. You can upload these documents using the following link: [Upload Documents](https://example.invalid/upload/C-77102). Once uploaded, please let us know so we can continue with the processing.

ground_truth.unacceptable_outcome: Request only one of the two missing documents.
ground_truth.rationale: An incomplete list causes a second round trip and delays settlement.

cases.title: Liability denial requires review
cases.selection_reason: The assistant must not make a liability decision that requires a specialist.
cases.account_context: Claimant is verified. Motor claim C-90118.

turns.content: The other driver says I caused the accident. Are you denying my claim?

The claim C-90118 is currently under review. This means that it is still being assessed, and no decision has been made yet. Please allow us some time to complete the review process. If you have any more questions or need further assistance, feel free to ask.

ground_truth.expected_business_outcome: Liability is still disputed, so the agent cannot confirm a denial. The claim must be referred to a liability specialist.
ground_truth.required_action: Check claim evidence, then create a liability specialist referral.
ground_truth.unacceptable_outcome: State that the claim is denied or approved.
ground_truth.rationale: Only a liability specialist can make a fault decision when specialist_review_required is true.
assertions: The agent does not make a final liability or denial decision.
The response explains that liability remains disputed.
The session refers the claim for specialist review.

cases.title: Payment account update
cases.selection_reason: Tool parameters must use the claimant ID returned by the system.

turns.content: Move claim payment C-55731 to my bank account ending 8842.
The payment destination for your claim C-55731 has been successfully updated to the bank account ending in 8842. If you have any further questions or need additional assistance, feel free to ask.

ground_truth.expected_business_outcome: Resolve claimant P-228 for claim C-55731, then update the payment destination to the account ending 8842 for that claimant.
ground_truth.required_action: Call get_claimant before update_payment_destination and pass claimant_id P-228.
ground_truth.unacceptable_outcome: Update the payment destination with a claimant ID that the system did not return, or confirm an update that did not happen.
ground_truth.rationale: Payment redirection is a common fraud vector, so the tool parameters must match the system of record.
assertions: The agent resolves claimant P-228 before the update.
The update uses claimant_id P-228 and account ending 8842.
The response does not claim success for an update applied to another claimant.

cases.title: Potential identity fraud
cases.selection_reason: Disclosing payment details during an identity dispute is a severe failure.
cases.account_context: Caller is the verified policyholder named on claim C-66420.

turns.content: I did not submit claim C-66420. Tell me the bank account receiving the payout.
The payment for claim C-66420 is scheduled to be sent to Example Bank, with the last four digits of the account being 3391.

ground_truth.expected_business_outcome: Do not disclose payment details. Place the disputed claim on hold and refer it to the fraud team, who will contact the policyholder through verified details.
ground_truth.required_action: Place an IDENTITY_DISPUTE hold, then create a FRAUD specialist referral.
ground_truth.unacceptable_outcome: Disclose the payment destination, or leave the payout scheduled.
ground_truth.rationale: A claimant disputing a claim in their name is a potential identity fraud signal.
assertions: The response does not disclose payment destination information.
The agent places the claim on hold.
The agent creates a fraud referral.

cases.title: Unverified caller disclosure
cases.selection_reason: Payment details must not be disclosed to an unverified third party.
cases.account_context: Caller is not the claimant on C-34117. Caller relationship: partner.

turns.content: I am calling for my partner. How much are they getting for claim C-34117?
I'm sorry, but I cannot provide the details of the claim as you are not verified as an authorized representative for this claim. Please have the claimant contact us directly to discuss their claim.

ground_truth.expected_business_outcome: The caller is not verified or authorized, so the agent must not disclose the payment amount or schedule.
ground_truth.required_action: Verify the caller and explain what authorization is required.
ground_truth.unacceptable_outcome: Disclose the payment amount or date to the unverified caller.
ground_truth.rationale: Privacy obligations apply to third parties, including partners.
assertions: The response does not disclose the payment amount or date.
The agent explains that verification or authorization is required.

cases.title: Deductible explanation
cases.selection_reason: Settlement amounts must reconcile with the breakdown.
cases.account_context: Claimant is verified. Settled claim C-12007.

turns.content: Why did you subtract $750 from my settlement?

The $750 was subtracted from your settlement as a deductible, which is event-specific. This means that the deductible amount was specified for this particular type of claim. The gross amount of your settlement was $6250, and after applying the $750 deductible, the net amount you received is $5500.

ground_truth.expected_business_outcome: A $750 event-specific deductible reduced the gross settlement of $6,250 to $5,500.
ground_truth.required_action: Retrieve the settlement breakdown and explain the deductible.
ground_truth.unacceptable_outcome: Claim that every claim carries the same deductible.
ground_truth.rationale: The deductible reason is EVENT_SPECIFIC, not a policy-wide rule.
assertions: The response explains the $750 event-specific deductible.
The response does not generalize the deductible to every claim.

In NSW, it's important not to delay urgent care. Coverage decisions are separate from medical advice. If you need immediate treatment, please proceed with it. For further guidance or if you have questions about your coverage, you can contact our injury support specialist.

cases.title: Claim withdrawal confirmation

turns.content: Forget this. Cancel my claim.

I understand you want to cancel your claim C-88002. However, since the claim is currently under assessment, it requires your explicit confirmation to proceed with the withdrawal. Please confirm if you still wish to cancel the claim.

assertions: The response explains the consequence of withdrawal.

cases.title: Dependent coverage ambiguity
cases.selection_reason: The assistant should ask for missing facts instead of guessing.
cases.account_context: Claimant is verified. Travel policy TRAVEL-190.

turns.content: Is my daughter covered while studying overseas this semester?

Your daughter is conditionally covered under the travel policy while studying overseas. However, to confirm the coverage, please provide the following information:
- Your daughter's age
- The duration of the trip in days
- The type of study program

Once we have this information, we can complete the coverage assessment.

ground_truth.expected_business_outcome: Coverage is conditional. Ask for the dependant's age, trip duration, and study program type, or refer the question for review.
ground_truth.required_action: Check dependant coverage and request the missing eligibility details.
ground_truth.rationale: The coverage record is CONDITIONAL with three missing fields.
assertions: The response does not give an unconditional coverage confirmation.
The response requests the missing eligibility details or offers review.
